---
title: "About"
---

A curated newsletter on **applied neurotechnology** — companies, clinical deployments, open-source tooling, and the AI and data science underneath. AI in neurotech is the lede whenever it's present: foundation models for neural data, brain-to-text and brain-to-speech decoders, novel architectures.

::: {.marks-note}
The logo just spells the name 〰️ for *neurotech* and ⚡ for *pulse*.
:::

Three cadences:

- **[Daily](daily/)** — terse, source-linked items from the past week.
- **[Weekly](weekly/)** — themes, *Frontier Watch*, what's worth watching next.
- **[Monthly](monthly/)** — top stories, one deep dive, UK jobs and funding.

Reach via [GitHub issues](https://github.com/bkowshik/neurotech-pulse/issues).
